correctness.rationale: Under exactly MK, Pos and Con, meet preservation is monotonicity and Pos at p=ceil((n-1)/2) is equivalent to f(p)>=p. For t<=floor((n-1)/2) and x<t, Con is automatic unless 2f(t)>n-1; in that case it forces f(x)=f(t). In even size the last lower input is either mapped below m or forces a constant raised prefix; in odd size the middle input is pinned at m or forces that prefix including itself. Counting weakly increasing tuples and summing over the raised prefix value gives the stated binomial squares and common additive term. Fixing the last output removes one free upper value; the dominant top-preserving proportion is m/(2m-1) in even size and 1/2 in odd size, with lower order corrections. The m=1 counts are (2,2) and (5,3). Inspected VERIFICATION.md and checker.py without executing the frozen code. Independent bounded replay: python3 /workspace/independent_checks.py tests all maps for n=2..7 and returns the stated pairs through (415,210); the structural argument proves the unrestricted result.
